import cyclopts
from typing import Annotated

app = cyclopts.App()

@app.default
def deploy(
    target: str,
    token: Annotated[str, cyclopts.Parameter(help="API token", env_var="DEPLOY_TOKEN")],
):
    print(f"Deploying to {target}")
    print(f"Using token: {token}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app()
